diagnostic: 2022 already observed; report all candidates, never select on it
cost: historical open and close-today fees, broker surcharge, prior-year tick, one tick per side; estimated cost < 6bp; reversal deviation > 3 times estimated cost
timing: A/B decide 09:16 enter 09:17; C/D decide 09:20 enter 09:21; all exit 11:30; delay stress enters one bar later

risk.budget: 1 / supported ex-ante annual universe size; no redistribution of cash

A: abs deviation from previous 15 closes > preceding 60-day own same-time 80/90 percentile; short high-clock >=2/3, long low-clock >=2/3 within 09:01-09:16
B: 80-percentile reversal, with/without AM extreme clock; open-to-close net movement / cumulative absolute path <=0.4 or <=0.6
C: A80/A90 or no-clock80; 09:17-09:20 no new directional extreme and close20 retraces close16; no retroactive 09:17 fill
D: close20 breaks first 15-minute high/low by more than one tick; first15 range >=3*estimated cost; compression range <=preceding 60-day median; volume variant volume20 >=1.5*preceding 60-day median volume20
walkforward: train 2016-2018 test 2019; train through2019 test2020; train through2020 test2021; separately choose each family by training cost*1.5 Sharpe, requiring >0 and >=30 trades, otherwise cash
admission: family walk-forward 2019-2021 Sharpe >=1.5, stress cost*1.5 Sharpe >=1, delay Sharpe >0, at least 100 total trades; family admission independent of 2022; no frozen winner in this experiment
combination: fixed 50/50 C and D walk-forward sleeves; no optimized weight; each family selected only using its earlier training years
uncertainty: 20-day circular whole-portfolio block bootstrap, seed20261005, 3000 resamples; descriptive unadjusted intervals, not multiple-testing corrected alpha claims
provenance: retrospective hypothesis generation; 2022 diagnosis known and reference report published2026; not pristine forward validation
